label: Voice speed
intent: Speech speeds up. Light: Play gives one beat as the faster speed engages, and the cadence marks bunch up behind it like cars braking in a queue: the middle mark slams into its tighter slot first, the far one 70 ms later, each hitting home and rebounding once. Strong: Play gathers, then beats harder while the marks first spread out, drive in faster and rebound twice. The first mark never moves; the marks stay at the tighter spacing. The reverse is the exact time reversal: the marks relax back out, far one first.

tick-2.x.//: v1's end state: tick-2 1.4 and tick-3 2.8 closer to Play
